culprit_citations.quoted_text: Eclipse Topco / Class A common units row: Shares/Units 261, Amortized Cost 261.0, Fair Value 279.7; the Principal column is blank in the SOI grid.
Amerivet Partners / Class A units row: Shares/Units 1,575, Amortized Cost 1,575.0, Fair Value dash; the Principal column is blank in the SOI grid.
Unity Purchaser / Class A-1 units row: Shares/Units 2,271,000, Amortized Cost 2,271.0, Fair Value 2,198.6; the Principal column is blank in the SOI grid.

findings.detail: Equity/unit SOI rows have populated Shares/Units but blank Principal, yet the extract populated principal_amount_usd for X06 row keys 471890, 471925, 472024, 472230, and 472763.
The repeated shape is a Shares/Units-to-principal remap on non-debt rows, not a valid principal amount greater than fair value.

rationale: Class 2 row validation: X06 flagged five principal_amount rows where principal_amount_usd exceeded fair value. Raw SOI grids show the implicated pattern is non-debt equity/unit rows with a Shares/Units value and no Principal value. Therefore the populated principal_amount_usd values are extraction defects caused by reading unit/share quantities as principal amounts.
